purpose: Adapters for Google-discovered and official-source-verified microscope-slide collection nodes added in 07J.
guards: Use broad web search for discovery but promote only after verifying an institutional or authoritative collection source.
Keep photographic slides, pinned specimens, wet lots, thin sections and microscope slides as separate media/count scopes.
For distributed exsiccata slide sets, treat each fascicle and recipient holding as separate batch/provenance layers.

adapters.institution_scope: Instituto de Biologia UNAM insect collections
adapters.target: official insect collection page with named collection subsections
adapters.promotion_rule: Extract each named insect collection separately and preserve microscopic-preparation counts independently from type/species totals.

adapters.institution_scope: Colecao Entomologica do Instituto Oswaldo Cruz
adapters.target: official CEIOC collection history and historical collection summary
adapters.promotion_rule: Treat each closed historical collection as a named batch; preserve slide, alcohol-tube, pinned and other preservation counts separately and follow catalogue/speciesLink only when collection identity persists.

adapters.institution_scope: Museu de Zoologia da Universidade de Sao Paulo Hemiptera
adapters.promotion_rule: Extract slide count as its own preservation category; retain steel-cabinet/drawer description as collection-wide physical context.

adapters.institution_scope: Universidade de Sao Paulo Laboratorio de Microarqueologia
adapters.target: official collection page for micromorphology thin sections
adapters.promotion_rule: Type these records explicitly as archaeological micromorphology thin sections and preserve site/project/experimental-series relations.

adapters.institution_scope: Universidad Nacional de Colombia Museo Entomologico UNAB
adapters.target: official museum page listing five named component collections
adapters.promotion_rule: Promote the named Coleccion de Laminas as a collection node while keeping the 180,000 total museum specimens out of the slide-count field.

adapters.institution_scope: University of Ibadan Department of Archaeology and Anthropology
adapters.target: official department page describing museum, laboratories and teaching collections
adapters.promotion_rule: Keep the 3,000+ microscope pollen/spore slides separate from the independently stated 3,000+ 35mm transparencies.

adapters.institution_scope: National Museum of Nature and Science Tokyo microalgae herbarium
adapters.target: Toshiharu Watanabe freshwater diatom collection database and collection history
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve staged donation events and use database records to connect slide/original material to species composition and the cited 2005 monograph.

adapters.institution_scope: National Museum of Nature and Science Tokyo freshwater algae exsiccata series
adapters.target: official Algae Aquae Dulcis Japonicae Exsiccatae series page
adapters.promotion_rule: Model each 20-slide fascicle as a published set and each recipient institution as a potential provenance edge; do not infer survival of recipient copies without object-side confirmation.
